lede: Standard workflows, no knobs beyond the basics. Nothing runs until you press the button.
tabDisabled: No model for this panel can load on this machine
catalogFailed: The model catalog did not load, so the model lists are empty. It is retried every minute.
preselectMissed: {{model}} is not available in this panel (it is not registered, or can never fit on these cards).

stream.cutOff: cut off at the token ceiling
stream.emptyLength: <err>Stopped at the max-tokens ceiling while still thinking — the answer never started.</err> The thought above is what the budget went on, and reading it tells you which of two things happened: a thought still going somewhere, which a larger Max tokens would let finish, or one circling a question with no clean resolution, where more budget only buys more circling. Turning Thinking off gives a direct answer.

chat.defaultPrompt: Explain in two sentences why the sky is blue.

load.off: {{model}} is switched off — it refuses jobs and cannot load. Set it to on demand or keep warm under Recipes first.
load.loaded: {{model}} is loaded — answers in about a second.
load.evicts: {{model}} is not loaded; running evicts resident instances to make room, so the first answer takes a while.
load.loads: {{model}} is not loaded — the first answer waits for it to load.

think.raised: Max tokens raised to {{floor}} — the thought is spent from this budget before the answer starts, and hard problems measured 10k–21k tokens; a smaller budget returns an empty answer, not a short one. It is a ceiling, so a short thought costs nothing.
think.canThink: It can reason; the Thinking switch turns that on.
think.noEffect: Thinking has no effect here — giq starts this model with reasoning off.

tools.defaultPrompt: Roll two six-sided dice and tell me the current time along with the total.
tools.hint: OpenAI-style tool calling (the MCP wire pattern): the model requests tools, the sandbox runs them here in the browser, and the model composes the final answer. Runs on {{model}}.
tools.unavailable: {{model}} is not available (not registered, switched off, or never fits), and it is the model this panel runs.
tools.noAnswer_one: No final answer: the model was still calling tools after {{count}} round.
tools.noAnswer_other: No final answer: the model was still calling tools after {{count}} rounds.

t2i.defaultPrompt: A cozy riverside town at dusk, warm windows glowing, graphic novel style
t2i.none: No text-to-image model fits on these cards.
t2i.evicts: Generating evicts the resident instances — the first image takes minutes, then they reload.

edit.defaultPrompt: Transform this photo into a watercolor illustration
edit.none: No image-edit model fits on these cards — panel disabled.
edit.evicts: Editing may evict resident instances — it can take a couple of minutes.

vision.none: No vision-capable model is registered — the panel has nothing to ask.
vision.noWeights: {{model}} is registered but its weights are not on disk — fetch the GGUF (and its mmproj) before asking.
vision.loadsFirst: Asking loads the model first — the first answer takes a while.

asr.recordHint: Record from the microphone or upload a file. A picked file wins over a recording.
asr.secureHint: Microphone capture needs a secure context (localhost or https) — file upload always works.
asr.needAudio: Pick an audio file (or record) first.
asr.speaker: Speaker

tts.defaultText: The GPU belongs to everyone — thirty seconds at a time.
tts.hint: {{model}} ({{size}}) loads on demand without evicting resident instances.

voice.hint: ecapa-tdnn voiceprints, cosine similarity — the same speaker typically scores ≥ 0.5, different speakers < 0.25.
